statement: This sketch creates a chaotic burst of vibrant pixel shapes that suddenly freeze into a structured, glowing tapestry upon user interaction. The initial animation simulates an energetic explosion of color and motion, but when the user clicks the canvas, it triggers a "glowing echo" that instantly halts all movement and resolves the chaos into a stable, luminous composition. The effect is achieved through careful control of particle behavior and a transition triggered by a single mouse press, resulting in a visually striking contrast between disorder and order.
